steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs across pages to build a set of liked song IDs.
liked_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    songs = page.get("songs", [])
    if not songs:
        break
    for song in songs:
        liked_song_ids.add(song["song_id"])
    if len(songs) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(liked_song_ids), sorted(liked_song_ids)[:10])

## Critical Context
- `spotify.login`: POST `/auth/token`, requires `username` (email) and `password`, returns `access_token`.
- `spotify.show_song_queue`: GET `/music_player/song_queue`, requires `access_token`, returns queue entries with `position`, `is_current`, and `is_playing`.
- `spotify.remove_song_from_queue`: DELETE `/music_player/song_queue/{position}`, requires 0-indexed `position` and `access_token`.
- `spotify.play_music`: POST `/music_player/play`, accepts at most one of `queue_position`, `song_id`, `album_id`, or `playlist_id`.
- `spotify.show_liked_songs`: GET `/liked_songs`, supports `page_index`, `page_limit` (1–20), and `sort_by` (`liked_at`, `play_count`, `title`, with `+/-` prefix).
